title: Each Fake News is Fake in its Own Way: An Attribution Multi-Granularity Benchmark for Multimodal Fake News Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical aspects of multimodal fake news detection and attribution (identifying patterns like image fabrication or event inconsistency). While it contains a brief 'Legal and Ethical' section concerning data privacy and anonymization, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral frameworks.
